en_title: Dataminers Uncover Five Possible DLC Characters for Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls
subtitle: 名单仍可能变动
opus_summary: 文件中发现五名潜在角色：奇异博士、黄蜂女、牌皇、石头人和夜魔侠。X0XLEAK称他们可能是原型或未来角色，座谈会上还公布凤凰镭射眼将于2026年秋季加入。

paragraphs.en: Now that Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls is officially out in the wild, dataminers have wasted no time digging through the game’s files, and they’ve found some interesting heroes mentioned within them.
paragraphs.cn: 如今《Marvel Tokon：Fighting Souls》已经正式推出，数据挖掘者便立即翻查了游戏文件，并在其中发现了几名有趣的英雄。

paragraphs.en: Marvel’s latest fighting game has had quite a week. After stuttering issues plagued the PC version upon launch, Arc System Works was quick to implement a fix , turning the tide of public opinion from dismal to delighted.
paragraphs.cn: 漫威这款最新格斗游戏最近可谓经历了不平凡的一周。游戏发售后，PC版一度饱受卡顿问题困扰，Arc System Works很快推出修复补丁，让舆论风向从一片悲观转为一片叫好。

paragraphs.en: Many blamed these PC problems on Arc System Works’ anti-datamining measures, which seem to have paid off; one reputable source claimed they couldn’t find much, crediting the developer for their efforts in ‘cleaning up’ the game’s data. In other comments, they said they haven’t come across anything new regarding upcoming costumes or DLC spoilers — but they did mention that they’ve seen assets for a future battle pass, and warned players to “get ready” for what’s next.
paragraphs.cn: 许多人将这些PC问题归咎于Arc System Works采取的反数据挖掘措施，而这些措施似乎确实奏效了。一位可靠的消息人士称，自己没能挖到多少内容，并称赞开发商努力「清理」游戏数据。在其他评论中，该消息人士表示，自己没有发现有关即将推出的服装或DLC剧透的新内容，不过提到看到了未来战斗通行证的素材，还提醒玩家要为接下来的内容「做好准备」。

paragraphs.en: btw, there's not much to datamine out of tokon in terms of unreleased content (thank god). arcsys has gotten really good about cleaning up in the last few years
paragraphs.cn: 「顺便说一句，就未发布内容而言，《Marvel Tokon》里没什么可供数据挖掘的（谢天谢地）。Arc System Works过去几年在清理数据方面已经相当在行了。」

paragraphs.en: the one thing i did find is battle pass assets, so uh. get ready lol
paragraphs.cn: 「我唯一找到的是战斗通行证素材，所以，呃，做好准备吧，哈哈。」

paragraphs.en: Notable datamining group X0XLEAK also chimed in with some discoveries, specifically mentioning five heroes they supposedly discovered during their excursion into Tokon’s files: Doctor Strange, Wasp, Gambit, The Thing, and Daredevil.
paragraphs.cn: 知名数据挖掘组织X0XLEAK也分享了自己的发现，具体提到他们在查阅《Marvel Tokon》文件时，据称发现了五名英雄：奇异博士、黄蜂女、牌皇、石头人和夜魔侠。

paragraphs.en: Their post also mentioned that these are "possible prototype/future characters" that are “subject to change," adding more confusion and speculation onto the subject. Given their description as potential prototype or DLC characters, it stands to reason that these aren't background assets, like some of the nonplayable heroes we've seen dotting Tokon's various stages.
paragraphs.cn: 该组织的帖子还提到，这些是「可能的原型／未来角色」，「可能会变更」，让围绕此事的讨论更加混乱，也引发了更多猜测。鉴于这些角色被描述为潜在的原型或DLC角色，因此可以合理推断，它们并非背景素材，不像我们此前在《Marvel Tokon》各个场景中看到的那些不可操作英雄。

paragraphs.en: Whatever the case may be, the mere mention of these names in Tokon’s data has stirred up a heated discussion on social media. Many players are arguing that the only truly unique addition to this roster is Wasp, noting that all the other characters on the list are already playable in Marvel Rivals .
paragraphs.cn: 不管怎样，仅仅是这些名字出现在《Marvel Tokon》的数据中，就已经在社交媒体上引发了激烈讨论。许多玩家认为，这份阵容中真正独特的新增角色只有黄蜂女，并指出名单上的其他角色都已经可以在《漫威争锋》中使用。

paragraphs.en: Possible prototype/Future characters mentioned in files
paragraphs.cn: 「文件中提到的可能原型／未来角色」

paragraphs.en: Tokon’s roster, similar to that of Rivals, has brought in some lesser-known characters from within the Marvel universe, but the two differ significantly as far as specific picks are concerned. For example, Tokon boasts a far wider variety of true-blue villains in Carnage, Dr. Doom, and Green Goblin. It’s also got a deep cut in Danger, giving the Mutant her first-ever fully playable role in a video game.
paragraphs.cn: 《Marvel Tokon》的阵容与《漫威争锋》相似，都从漫威宇宙中选入了一些冷门角色，但两款游戏在具体选角上存在显著差异。比如，《Marvel Tokon》加入了更多真正的反派角色，包括屠杀、毁灭博士和绿魔。此外，游戏还选入了冷门角色Danger，让这名变种人首次在电子游戏中以完整可操作角色登场。

paragraphs.en: For now, it’s anyone’s guess as to who’ll appear in Tokon next, but we did get some information regarding future DLC characters at San Diego Comic Con this year. During a panel, it was revealed that Phoenix Cyclops will be the next character to join the fray, leading a team with as-yet unknown members (though it’s likely we see more members of the Phoenix Force).
paragraphs.cn: 目前还没人知道《Marvel Tokon》接下来会有谁登场，不过，我们确实在今年的圣迭戈动漫展上获得了一些有关未来DLC角色的信息。在一场座谈会上，官方透露凤凰镭射眼将是下一位加入战斗的角色，并会带领一支成员尚未公布的队伍（不过，我们很可能还会看到更多凤凰之力成员登场）。

paragraphs.en: Cyclops comes to Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls in Fall 2026. Until then, you can read our glowing review of the game, which IGN’s own Mitchell Saltzman scored a 9 out of 10 .
paragraphs.cn: 镭射眼将于2026年秋季加入《Marvel Tokon：Fighting Souls》。在那之前，你可以先阅读我们对本作的好评评测；IGN的Mitchell Saltzman为游戏打出了9分（满分10分）。
